definition.adjacent_drop: S_restore(to_layer) minus S_restore(from_layer), paired by seed
definition.ci95: percentile seed-cluster bootstrap, 50000 draws, counts kept together within seed
definition.endpoint_minus_ordinary: (full minus ordinary) minus (full minus endpoint) = endpoint minus ordinary
definition.mean: equal-weight mean over ten confirmation seed units
definition.p_value: two-sided exact sign flip over 2^10 seed effects; nominal p<0.05, no multiplicity correction
definition.primary: full-needle expected-error repair minus equal-token-budget ordinary restoration repair
definition.unit: mean over counts 1-10 within each confirmation seed
